images.prompt: Create one premium travel website hero, wide landscape 16:9, photorealistic editorial illustration of San Cristobal island in the Galapagos, Ecuador. Pacific ocean view of the recognizable Leon Dormido (Kicker Rock) volcanic formation off San Cristobal: two weathered vertical dark tuff rock masses split by a narrow sea channel, the larger sheer uneven angular rock on one side and slimmer tall stack on the other, natural sea birds small in scale. Rich clear deep blue water with a little turquoise nearer rocks, low green-brown island shore subtly in distant background, soft bright equatorial daylight. No arches, no additional massive stacks, no giant animals or boats foreground, no tropical coconut forest. Wide uncluttered travel view from water at a distance, subject right of center with generous sea and sky on left for title, subtle realistic texture and color, no text, logos, watermark or collage.
